scope: execution gates, held-out split ceremony, ablation set and two-house P0, for every VM-04 and VM-05 step from D-219 onward
motivation: the 12-20 week estimate was dominated by self-imposed protocol, not by science; a second-quartile journal reviewer never sees the ceremony, only the fairness floor

replaces.d212_two_commit_gate: reviewed implementation commit plus a separate single-file activation commit whose parent must equal the reviewed commit
replaces.observed_failure: the D-218 gate became unsatisfiable at docs commit c8b4c688d9f9e0e73c2490271daf332b3439d953, because one documentation commit moved HEAD^ away from the reviewed implementation commit and locked an already authorized stage

replacement.authorization_is_expressed_by: the authorization booleans in the step contract, reviewed by the user before the run

unchanged_invariants: no results-driven change to split, threshold, house set or sample replacement
failures are retained without substitution or resampling
test and audit are read once

held_out_split.replaces: sealed confirmation family with hidden house IDs, commitment digests, salt-shuffled episode IDs and a reveal interface

vsmt_ablations_required.VSMT-Flat8: measures the value of the typed transaction gate
vsmt_ablations_required.VSMT-NoVersion: measures the value of model-visible version history

internal_controls_required.NECS: sealed teacher targets without candidate post-state or delta features; the single causal ablation for the executable revision space claim

method_and_ablation_set.shared_budget_unchanged: every retained arm and ablation keeps the same frontend, data, candidate source, training budget and scoring

two_house_p0.replaces: twelve sealed slots with per-route seals, qualification receipts and a full ceremony

retained_scenarios.P01: capture, three-face raw writing and shared cache
retained_scenarios.P08: structural head plus multi-view fragment full chain

fairness_floor_may_not_be_simplified: all five primary arms read identical frozen public front-end cache bytes
house-level separation of train, validation and test
test is run once and may not change the model
candidates are generated and sealed before any teacher or private truth is opened
candidate miss, teacher error and selector amortization error are reported separately
multiple seeds, confidence intervals, failure cases and resource cost are reported
P08 private metadata is opened only after predictions and routes are fixed
a strong baseline may not be removed because it performs well

superseded_contract_clauses.d219_activation_policy: the single-file activation commit requirement is replaced by run_authorization_policy above
